name: Debris
description: Two federal agents from two different continents, and two different mindsets, must work together to investigate when wreckage from a destroyed alien spacecraft has mysterious effects on humankind.

videos.title: Pilot
videos.overview: Two agents, from two different continents, and two different mindsets, must work together to investigate when wreckage from a destroyed alien spacecraft has mysterious effects on humankind.

videos.title: You Are Not Alone
videos.overview: Bryan and Finola investigate Debris that is mysteriously dragging metal from an evacuated town for an unknown purpose. Bryan is forced to keep his secret about Finola's father's survival.

videos.title: Solar Winds
videos.overview: When Bryan and Finola investigate a mysterious, otherworldly square that has appeared in a field, they come to understand new revelations about our planet. Maddox meets with an old contact.

videos.title: In Universe
videos.overview: When the Debris creates a strange rainstorm over a farm in Nebraska, Bryan and Finola must treat the situation like they are stepping foot onto an alien planet.

videos.title: Earthshine
videos.overview: INFLUX steps out from the shadows, weaponizing the debris in a terrifying experiment. Finola struggles to keep her newfound knowledge from affecting her work.

videos.title: Supernova
videos.overview: When the team investigates a group of teenagers who are using Debris to kill the elderly, Bryan faces increasing pressure from Maddox to get answers out of Finola.

videos.title: You Can Call Her Caroline
videos.overview: Bryan and Finola head to Maine to pursue an INFLUX lead, but they discover a volatile situation where a young girl has lost her father to debris. Maddox learns Anson's secrets.

videos.title: Spaceman
videos.overview: Bryan and Finola undertake a dangerous operation into an INFLUX compound in order to rescue George Jones. But Maddox and Ferris have their own plans for how the mission should be carried out.

videos.title: Do You Know Icarus? (1)
videos.overview: While Bryan and Finola figure out their next move, a diver finds debris off the coast and accidentally erases his sister from reality.

videos.title: I Am Icarus (2)
videos.overview: The mystery deepens as Bryan and Finola attempt to right what has gone wrong, and prevent the fabric of reality from unwinding.

videos.title: Asalah
videos.overview: When a woman who has been affected by the Debris is found with knowledge of Bryan's past, he is forced to confront his trauma.

videos.title: A Message from Ground Control
videos.overview: As George grows closer to finding what he is after, the Debris that Orbital has collected begins a mysterious process.

videos.title: Celestial Body
videos.overview: Bryan and Finola’s lives are changed forever as Maddox and INFLUX converge on the Debris they seek.
